services.title: Air Freight Forwarding
services.description: Next-flight-out express delivery for urgent cargo.
services.details:
Our Air Freight services provide reliable and cost-effective domestic and international cargo movement through strategic contracts with leading airlines and a wide network of IATA-certified agents. By leveraging multiple carrier options, we ensure optimal routing, competitive pricing, and timely delivery for shipments of all sizes across the globe.

Advantages:
- Access to competitive rates through multiple domestic and international carriers.
- Transit times comparison to select best airline and route selection as per your requirement.
- Global coverage under one roof.
- Professional handling as certified, experienced and well equipped partners.

services.title: Road Freight Forwarding
services.details:
End-to-end road transportation PAN India basis. supported by a readily available fleet for all container types. Whether Trucks all sizes, Trailers all sizes, standard, reefer, flatbed containers etc, our road transport solutions are structured to ensure quick deployment, safe handling, and on-time delivery along with real time tracking.

Advantages:
- Access to thousands of trucking companies, thereby, fulfilling your requirement within minutes.
- Faster vehicle placement with optimised routing.
- Seamless point to point movement.
- Transparent and ready rate structures with instant booking.

services.title: Warehousing
services.details:
Need a modern warehousing space for your requirement no matter how much space. ASK US!! With Plethora of space available all across the nation, we take your burden to find and provide warehouse space even for as low as 1000 Sq. Ft. to as much as you want. From Basic to Advanced to Green warehousing space.

Advantages:
- Our secure warehouse facilities provide a safe and climate-controlled environment for storing goods.
- We offer flexible storage solutions, including inventory management and cargo handling services.
- Our warehouses are equipped with state-of-the-art security systems and surveillance cameras.

services.title: Custom Clearance
services.description: Automated compliance clearing and duty payments.
services.details:
Customs compliance shouldn't block your supply chain. Our certified brokerage team handles document preparation, tariff classification, duty valuation, and electronic processing for all import/export entries. We ensure rapid clearance times and prevent unexpected port delays or compliance penalty issues.

Advantages:
- Quick customs declaration preparation.
- Document compliance pre-verification.
- Direct connections with local port authorities.
- Safe cargo handling and storage inside customs area.

services.title: CFS
services.description: Container Freight Station handling and consolidation.
services.details:
Our specialized Container Freight Station (CFS) operations handle efficient cargo consolidation and deconsolidation. We coordinate container stuffing and stripping for LCL shipments, safe transfer of heavy items, and cross-border manifest preparation to ensure streamlined transit operations at every port.

Advantages:
- Efficient FCL/LCL consolidation services.
- Safe and secure container stuffing and stripping.
- Real-time container movement tracking.
- Bonded and non-bonded warehouse storage areas.

services.title: Contract Handling
services.description: Enterprise logistics contract execution and planning.
services.details:
Manage complex logistics projects and supply chain setups under dedicated SLA contracts. We design custom handling routines, verify safety audits, and dedicate specialized machinery/teams to guarantee high-performance cargo routing and contract compliance.

Advantages:
- Custom logistics solution design.
- Dedicated equipment and expert operations teams.
- Full supply chain audit compliance.
- Strategic routing optimization.

services.title: Cargo Insurance
services.details:
Protect your transit investments with complete cargo insurance options. We offer comprehensive liability coverage against physical damage, theft, or unforeseen cargo loss during marine, air, or road transportation. Instant certificate issuance and simplified claims processing keep your business protected.

Advantages:
- All-risk coverage for global shipments.
- Flexible policies adjusted for cargo valuation.
- Direct integration with top global underwriters.
- Rapid online claims submission and processing.

faqs.question: How are freight rates calculated?
faqs.answer: Rates are based on weight/volume, route, fuel surcharges, and current port handling tariffs.

faqs.question: What documents are required for customs clearance?
faqs.answer: Standard clearance requires a Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, and Certificate of Origin.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a scheduled container booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 72 hours prior to cargo cut-off time.
